name: Methylbutyltryptamine
summary: Methylbutyltryptamine (MBT), also known as N-methyl-N-butyltryptamine, is a lesser-known psychedelic drug of the tryptamine family related to dimethyltryptamine (DMT).

fact.en: Methylbutyltryptamine carries one methyl and one butyl group on its nitrogen, making it a lopsided cousin of DMT and of DBT, which carries two butyl groups.
fact.zh: Methylbutyltryptamine 的氮原子上接著一個甲基和一個丁基，是 DMT 與帶兩個丁基的 DBT 之間一個不對稱的表親。
fact.zhHans: Methylbutyltryptamine 的氮原子上接着一个甲基和一个丁基，是 DMT 与带两个丁基的 DBT 之间一个不对称的表亲。
